Rust struct with name, verify structure name contains value

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `rust`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`pub struct MyConfig {
    pub name: String,
    pub value: i32,
}

impl MyConfig {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { name: String::new(), value: 0 }
    }
}
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Structure)
}
```
